Project Overview: Fab 62 is an advanced semiconductor fabrication facility for Intel Corporation, located at Intel's Ocotillo campus in Chandler, Arizona.

As part of this work, the M&T team is responsible for delivering the engineering, procurement, and construction scope required to complete and finish-out a leading-edge chipmaking facility - a highly demanding environment where precision, cleanliness, schedule certainty, and coordination across thousands of craft and professional personnel are essential to success.

The project supports the continued expansion of domestic semiconductor manufacturing capacity, contributing to a more resilient technology supply chain while creating significant opportunity for the local Arizona workforce.

Joining the Fab 62 team means contributing directly to one of the most strategically important construction efforts in the United States and helping deliver the infrastructure behind the next generation of microelectronics.

Job Summary: In this role, you will lead electrical field engineering support for assigned construction areas on a large, complex semiconductor project.

You will provide technical direction to field engineers and construction teams, support construction-driven planning and Advanced Work Packaging, help ensure work packages are ready for execution, and coordinate across engineering, construction, procurement, quality, project controls, startup, subcontractors, and client teams.

This position supports safe and efficient field execution through drawing and specification review, constructability and issue resolution, material and quantity tracking, progress reporting, inspection, testing, punch list closure, and turnover of completed electrical systems. #LI-CL1 Major Responsibilities: Lead electrical field engineering support for assigned construction areas, including planning, technical coordination, field issue resolution, inspection, testing, and turnover.

Provide daily direction and mentoring to field engineers while ensuring work is performed safely and in accordance with current drawings, specifications, procedures, and approved work packages.

Support construction-driven planning using Advanced Work Packaging principles, including work package development, sequencing, constraint removal, quantity tracking, and workface readiness.

Coordinate with construction, engineering, procurement, quality, project controls, startup, subcontractors, and client representatives to resolve technical and constructability issues. Review construction drawings, specifications, models, vendor data, material requirements, RFIs, and field changes to support timely and practical field execution.

Help ensure labor, materials, drawings, access, permits, inspections, equipment, and work packages are ready before work begins. Support material readiness, progress reporting, installed quantity verification, quality documentation, punch list closure, and turnover of completed electrical systems.

Promote a safe, collaborative, and accountable field engineering culture focused on quality, continuous improvement, and successful project delivery.

Education and Experience Requirements: Requires bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) and 8-10 years of relevant experience or 12-14 years of relevant work experience Required Knowledge and Skills: Strong knowledge of electrical construction methods, materials, installation practices, testing, inspection, and turnover requirements.

Ability to read, interpret, and apply construction drawings, specifications, models, vendor information, quality requirements, and project procedures. Experience with field engineering, Advanced Work Packaging, workface planning, work package development, quantity tracking, progress reporting, and turnover support.

Demonstrated leadership skills, including setting priorities, mentoring field engineers, coordinating technical support, and supporting construction execution. Effective communication and coordination skills with construction, engineering, procurement, quality, project controls, startup, subcontractors, and client teams.

Working knowledge of construction automation, document control, completions, punch list, material management, and progress tracking systems. Ability to identify constraints, resolve constructability issues, manage competing priorities, and make sound field decisions with a strong commitment to safety, quality, and teamwork.

Welcome to the intersection of energy and home services. At NRG, we’re driven by our passion to create a smarter, cleaner and more connected future.
Vivint Smart Home, an NRG owned company, is a leading smart home company in the United States, dedicated to redefining the home experience with intelligent products and services. We find purpose in proactively protecting and keeping our customers connected to home, no matter where they are. Join the Smart Home team to create smarter, safer and more sustainable homes.
Field Service Technician/Professional
Do you have the drive to succeed, the desire to grow your career, and the people skills to connect? In this role, technical expertise meets sales opportunity. You will be the face of Vivint, installing cutting-edge smart home technology while proactively identifying and selling upgraded solutions to provide customers with total peace of mind. Vivint—named one of Forbe’s World’s 50 Most Innovative Companies—is looking for Field Service Technicians to join our nationally recognized team.

Total Compensation: Competitive hourly base pay + uncapped commission and performance incentives.
Comprehensive, Paid Training: Virtual & on-the-job training, as well as ongoing coaching & support from leaders & teammates who care about your success.
Zero Commute: Take-home company vehicle and gas card for work use. We pay for your drive time to and from appointments—you clock in from your driveway.
Work-Life Balance: 4-day work weeks (4/10 schedule, includes Saturdays) to give you more time for what matters.
Fully Equipped: We provide all tools, a cell phone, a tablet, and paid licensing required for job duties.
The Perks: 10 paid holidays, 2 weeks PTO, 401(k) with 6% match, an Employee Stock Purchase Program & employee pricing on Smart Home equipment.
Adventure: Opportunity to earn a yearly company-paid incentive trip (plus one guest!).

As a Field Professional, you are the ultimate smart home expert. Your day-to-day includes:
Technical Excellence: Installing, servicing, and troubleshooting security cameras, smart locks, and home automation systems.
Consultative Sales: Evaluating customer homes to recommend and sell equipment upgrades or service enhancements on-site.
Customer Education: Training homeowners on how to use their new system to protect their families.
Growth: Benefiting from consistent coaching and leadership training to move up within our national organization.

We hire for attitude and train for skill. Whether you are an experienced technician or a sales pro looking for a hands-on change, we want to hear from you if you have:
A Sales Mindset: Experience in retail, B2C sales, insurance, or service-based sales is a major plus.
Customer First Attitude: Ability to act with integrity while building rapport with diverse customers.
Technical Aptitude: Experience in cable/satellite install, pest control, construction, or solar is helpful but not required.
Requirements: A valid driver’s license and a good driving record; ability to successfully pass post-offer background investigation and licensing requirements per applicable law.

Ability to lift and carry up to 45 lbs.
Ability to climb ladders (up to 14 feet, including ability when carrying tools to meet weight capacity requirements for company-approved ladders, i.e. 375 lbs) and work in confined spaces like attics.
Comfortable bending, kneeling, and standing for extended periods.
Safety culture is strong at Vivint. Field Service technicians will conduct a safety analysis of every home to ensure a safe workplace for the technician and the customers.
Ready to transform your career? Apply today to join the Vivint team!

Die unimon GmbH ist seit Januar 2025 Teil der GWF Gruppe und wächst sowie entwickelt sich sehr dynamisch weiter – und so wollen wir auch das Erlebnis für unsere Kunden auf eine neue Ebene bringen.
Sind Sie bereit, die Welt zu verändern und einen echten Unterschied zu machen? Dann werden Sie Teil unseres kleinen, hochkompetenten unimon\-Teams und prägen den nächsten Entwicklungsschritt unserer Firma. Wir arbeiten an und mit spannenden Technologien für das nachhaltige Management unserer wertvollsten Ressource Wasser und helfen unseren Kunden beim Aufbau einer wasserpositiven Welt, welche mit nachhaltiger Energie versorgt wird.
Ihre Aufgaben
Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehört die Installation, Wartung und Inbetriebnahme unserer Messtechnik\-Systeme in der Region östlich von Luzern. Sie übernehmen die Fehlerdiagnose und Reparatur von Anlagen sowohl vor Ort bei unseren Kunden als auch in unserem Werk. Zudem beraten und schulen Sie unsere Kunden im Umgang mit unseren Produkten.

Sie leisten technischen Support und finden Lösungen bei individuellen Anforderungen. Abschliessend dokumentieren Sie die Einsätze und tragen zur kontinuierlichen Optimierung der Serviceprozesse bei.
Nebst dem Einsatz im Aussendienst sind Sie zu ca. 50% am Standort Luzern präsent. Dort übernehmen Sie Aufgaben wie die Warenannahme, die Erstellung von RMAs, die Koordination von Rücksendungen sowie weitere logistische Themen.
Ihr Profil
Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung, idealerweise im Bereich Umwelt\-, Elektro\- oder Versorgungstechnik. Erste Erfahrungen im Bereich der Wasserqualitätsmesstechnik, im Service\-Aussendienst oder in der Messtechnik sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Ihre Begeisterung für Technik und Ihre Bereitschaft, sich in unsere innovativen Systeme einzuarbeiten, zeichnen Sie aus. Mit Kommunikationsstärke, einer ausgeprägten Serviceorientierung und Freude am Umgang mit Menschen werden Sie zum perfekten Teammitglied. Reisebereitschaft (vorwiegend national) und einen Führerschein runden Ihr Profil ab.

Gute bis sehr gute Kenntnisse in ösisch sind wünschenswert, aber keine Voraussetzung.
Doch nicht nur Ihre Qualifikationen zählen – auch Ihre Persönlichkeit ist uns wichtig. Wir suchen jemanden, der unsere Vision teilt und den Drang verspürt, einen echten Mehrwert und Impact zu schaffen. Ihre Begeisterung für den Umweltschutz und Ihre hohe Eigenmotivation treiben sie an, jeden Tag Ihr Bestes zu geben.
Wir bieten Ihnen
Wenn Sie sich in einem dynamischen Umfeld wohlfühlen und bereit sind, gemeinsam mit uns an Projekten von höchster gesellschaftlicher Relevanz zu arbeiten, dann sind Sie bei uns genau richtig. Wir bieten Ihnen die Möglichkeit, Ihre Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln und aktiv zur Verbesserung unserer Umwelt beizutragen.
Klingt das nach Ihnen? Dann bewerben Sie sich jetzt und werden Sie Teil unserer Mission.
